name: speakspace
description: SpeakSpace Local — 本地优先的语音笔记与知识工作台 / Local-first voice notes and knowledge workspace

scripts.build:dll: cross-env NODE_ENV=development TS_NODE_TRANSPILE_ONLY=true NODE_OPTIONS="-r ts-node/register --no-warnings" webpack --config ./.erb/configs/webpack.config.renderer.dev.dll.ts
scripts.build:main: cross-env NODE_ENV=production TS_NODE_TRANSPILE_ONLY=true NODE_OPTIONS="-r ts-node/register --no-warnings" webpack --config ./.erb/configs/webpack.config.main.prod.ts
scripts.build:renderer: cross-env NODE_ENV=production TS_NODE_TRANSPILE_ONLY=true NODE_OPTIONS="-r ts-node/register --no-warnings" webpack --config ./.erb/configs/webpack.config.renderer.prod.ts
scripts.postinstall: node -r ts-node/register .erb/scripts/check-native-dep.js && node ./node_modules/electron-builder/cli.js install-app-deps && node .erb/scripts/check-electron-binary.js && npm run build:dll
scripts.package: npm run clean && npm run build && electron-builder build --config electron-builder.js --publish never && node .erb/scripts/verify-signing.js && npm run build:dll
scripts.prestart: node .erb/scripts/ensure-dependencies.js && node .erb/scripts/check-electron-binary.js && cross-env NODE_ENV=development TS_NODE_TRANSPILE_ONLY=true NODE_OPTIONS="-r ts-node/register --no-warnings" webpack --config ./.erb/configs/webpack.config.main.dev.ts
scripts.start:preload: cross-env NODE_ENV=development TS_NODE_TRANSPILE_ONLY=true NODE_OPTIONS="-r ts-node/register --no-warnings" webpack --config ./.erb/configs/webpack.config.preload.dev.ts
scripts.start:renderer: cross-env NODE_ENV=development TS_NODE_TRANSPILE_ONLY=true NODE_OPTIONS="-r ts-node/register --no-warnings" webpack serve --config ./.erb/configs/webpack.config.renderer.dev.ts
scripts.package:release: node .erb/scripts/check-release-signing.js && npm run clean && npm run build && cross-env SPEAKSPACE_RELEASE=true electron-builder build --config electron-builder.js --publish never && cross-env SPEAKSPACE_RELEASE=true node .erb/scripts/verify-signing.js && npm run build:dll
scripts.bench:stt:fetch: cross-env ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 NODE_PATH=release/app/node_modules TS_NODE_TRANSPILE_ONLY=true electron -r ./scripts/benchmark/register-shared-alias.js -r ./scripts/benchmark/register-electron-app-stub.js -r ts-node/register/transpile-only scripts/benchmark/install-whisper-runtime.ts
scripts.bench:tts: cross-env NODE_PATH=release/app/node_modules TS_NODE_TRANSPILE_ONLY=true node -r ts-node/register/transpile-only scripts/benchmark/tts-benchmark.ts
scripts.bench:tts:asr: cross-env NODE_PATH=release/app/node_modules TS_NODE_TRANSPILE_ONLY=true node -r ts-node/register/transpile-only scripts/benchmark/tts-asr-eval.ts
scripts.bench:stt: cross-env NODE_PATH=release/app/node_modules TS_NODE_TRANSPILE_ONLY=true node -r ts-node/register/transpile-only scripts/benchmark/stt-human-eval.ts
scripts.bench:tts:memory: cross-env NODE_PATH=release/app/node_modules TS_NODE_TRANSPILE_ONLY=true node -r ts-node/register/transpile-only scripts/benchmark/tts-memory-probe.ts
scripts.bench:tts:length: cross-env NODE_PATH=release/app/node_modules TS_NODE_TRANSPILE_ONLY=true node -r ts-node/register/transpile-only scripts/benchmark/tts-length-scaling.ts
scripts.bench:agent:seed: cross-env ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 NODE_PATH=release/app/node_modules TS_NODE_TRANSPILE_ONLY=true electron -r ./scripts/benchmark/register-shared-alias.js -r ts-node/register/transpile-only scripts/benchmark/agent-eval-seed.ts
scripts.bench:agent: cross-env ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 NODE_PATH=release/app/node_modules TS_NODE_TRANSPILE_ONLY=true electron -r ./scripts/benchmark/register-shared-alias.js -r ts-node/register/transpile-only scripts/benchmark/agent-eval.ts
scripts.bench:retrieval: cross-env ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 NODE_PATH=release/app/node_modules TS_NODE_TRANSPILE_ONLY=true electron -r ./scripts/benchmark/register-shared-alias.js -r ts-node/register/transpile-only scripts/benchmark/embedding-retrieval-eval.ts
